result.brief: 提出 SCG，从最小 ViT 编码器出发，按任务复杂度以函数保持方式逐步扩展宽度/深度，并用 SIGReg 维持语义维度独立、防止表征坍缩，提升 JEPA 世界模型编码器的参数与数据效率。
result.reason: Proposes task-driven width/depth growth for JEPA world-model ViT encoders with function-preserving expansion and SIGReg preventing representation collapse, directly advancing visual representation learning for world models.
